protocol.pstate: 0.5 s deterministic pinned busy loop before every timed bench run
protocol.ours: engine-resident, structure's own bench; no result serialization
protocol.controls: DuckDB 2.0.0 threads=1 (config), forced full aggregation (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (.. GROUP BY ..)) so client materialization is excluded; MV control = same convention over the pre-aggregated table; CLI controls = in-process query_ms over repeated launches
protocol.exactness: element-wise full grouped result vs DuckDB 2.0.0 (group, SUM, COUNT(*), MIN, MAX; NULL groups matched as NULL)
